title: DSA Loan Agent Commission: Rates & Payout Structure 2026
summary: DSA loan agent commission explained: payout structure, personal, home and business loan commission rates, real earning examples, and GroMo's commission range.
body_markdown:
**DSA loan agent commission** is the money a bank or NBFC pays a[loan agent](https://gromo.in/blog/what-is-a-loan-agent/) for bringing them a loan customer. It is usually a percentage of the loan amount that gets disbursed, paid monthly. The rates look small, 0.3% to 2.5%, but the amounts are not: 1.5% on a Rs 10 lakh personal loan is Rs 15,000 from one file.


This guide explains the full DSA payout structure in simple words: product-wise commission rates for personal, home, and business loans, how and when the money reaches you, what can reduce it, and real examples with math. We also share the live commission range on GroMo, which often pays a higher percentage than the classic DSA range.


## DSA Commission at a Glance


**Commission basis** Percentage of the disbursed loan amount


**Typical range** 0.3% to 2.5%, by product and lender


**Paid when** Only after the loan is disbursed


**Payout cycle** Monthly, to your bank account


**Deductions** TDS before payout; GST if you cross the yearly limit


**Risk to know** Clawback if a loan closes or defaults very early


## DSA Commission Rates by Loan Product


Rates differ by lender, location, and your monthly volume, but these are the typical industry ranges:


Loan product Typical DSA commission On a Rs 10 lakh disbursal


Personal loan 1% - 2.5% Rs 10,000 - 25,000


Business loan 1% - 2.5% Rs 10,000 - 25,000


Home loan 0.3% - 1% Rs 3,000 - 10,000 (but tickets are much bigger)


Loan against property 0.5% - 1.5% Rs 5,000 - 15,000


Car loan 0.5% - 2% Rs 5,000 - 20,000


Gold loan 0.5% - 1.5% Rs 5,000 - 15,000


Two things to notice. Personal and business loans pay the highest percentage. Home loans pay a lower percentage, but the loan amounts are 5-10 times bigger, so one home loan file can still pay Rs 15,000-50,000. That is why experienced DSAs love home loans despite the smaller rate.


## How the DSA Payout Structure Works


Part of the payout structure How it works


Paid on disbursal You earn only when the loan money is actually released. Rejected or cancelled files pay nothing.


Monthly payout cycle Lenders total your disbursals for the month and pay by a fixed date in the next month, straight to your bank account.


Volume slabs Many banks pay a higher rate as your monthly disbursal grows. Example: 1% up to Rs 25 lakh a month, 1.5% above it.


TDS deduction Lenders deduct TDS (usually 2% under section 194H after the yearly limit) before paying you. Adjust it in your tax return.


GST If your yearly commission crosses Rs 20 lakh, you need GST registration and bill the lender with GST added.


Clawback If a loan closes or defaults very early (often within 6 months), part of your commission can be taken back.


## Real Earning Examples


Monthly work Disbursal At 1.5%


2 personal loans of Rs 3 lakh each Rs 6 lakh Rs 9,000


4 personal loans + 1 business loan Rs 20 lakh Rs 30,000


Above + 1 home loan of Rs 40 lakh (at 0.5%) Rs 60 lakh Rs 50,000


This is why DSA income grows in steps: the same follow-up skills that close a Rs 3 lakh[personal loan](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-get-personal-loan/) also close a Rs 40 lakh home loan, and referrals compound month after month.


## GroMo Loan Commission Range


**Commission basis** Percentage of the loan amount, per approved application


**Overall range** 0.5% up to 4%, by lender and campaign


**Most personal loans** 1.5% to 3.5%


**Top payers now** Digi Credit up to 4%; Lendingplate, ASAP Finance, Zapcash up to 3.5%; KreditBee, InCred around 3.1%


**Business loans** 1% to 1.75%


**Where to verify** Live payout shown on each product in the GroMo app


On GroMo, loan commissions work the same way as a DSA payout: a **percentage of the loan amount** , paid per approved application. The table above shows the live range across GroMo's lending partners.


Simple math: help someone get a Rs 2 lakh personal loan at 3% and you earn up to Rs 6,000 from one application. That is equal to or better than the classic bank DSA range of 1-2.5%.


Why start here instead of a single-bank DSA code? One free registration covers 30+ lending partners, so a customer rejected by one lender can be moved to another instead of being lost. The app tracks every application like a DSA portal. And the same customer can take a credit card, savings account, or demat account through you later, which percentage-only loan DSAs cannot offer. Commission rates change with campaigns, so always check the live payout shown on each product inside the GroMo app.


## How to Increase Your DSA Commission


1. Send complete files: full documents and correct details get approved faster and build your reputation with the lender.
2. Match the customer to the right lender instead of forcing one bank on everyone; approval rate is your real income rate.
3. Climb volume slabs by being consistent every month, not big one month and absent the next.
4. Add home loans once you are confident; lower percentage on much bigger amounts means bigger payouts.
5. Ask every disbursed customer for one referral; a happy borrower's reference is the cheapest lead you will ever get.
6. Keep records of every file and payout, and reconcile with the lender's statement monthly.


## FAQ: DSA Loan Agent Commission


**How much commission does a DSA loan agent earn?**


Typically 0.3% to 2.5% of the disbursed loan amount, depending on the product. Personal and business loans pay 1-2.5%, home loans pay 0.3-1% on much larger amounts, and loan against property sits around 0.5-1.5%. A DSA disbursing Rs 20 lakh a month at 1.5% earns Rs 30,000 that month, before TDS.


**What is the DSA payout structure?**


You are paid a percentage of every disbursed loan, totalled monthly and credited to your bank account in the next cycle. Many lenders raise your rate as your monthly volume crosses slabs. TDS is deducted before payout, GST applies if your yearly commission crosses the limit, and early loan closure or default can claw back part of the commission per your agreement.


**What is the home loan commission for an agent?**


Home loan DSA commission usually ranges from 0.3% to 1% of the disbursed amount across major banks. The percentage looks small, but tickets are large: 0.5% on a Rs 50 lakh home loan is Rs 25,000 from one file. Exact rates differ by bank, city, and your volume slab, and are set in your DSA agreement.


**What is the business loan commission for an agent?**


Business loan commissions typically run 1% to 2.5% of disbursal, similar to personal loans, because lenders value good business borrowers. Secured business loans and larger tickets may pay a lower percentage. As always, complete files and genuine borrowers keep your effective earnings high by avoiding rejections and clawbacks.


**What is the personal loan agent commission on GroMo?**


GroMo pays personal loan commission as a percentage of the loan amount, currently ranging from about 0.5% up to 4% depending on the lending partner and campaign. Most partners pay 1.5% to 3.5%, with lenders like Digi Credit, Lendingplate, and ASAP Finance at the top of the band. On a Rs 2 lakh approved loan at 3%, that is up to Rs 6,000. Rates change with campaigns, so check the live payout inside the GroMo app before sharing.


**Do DSA agents earn monthly or per loan?**


Both, in effect. You earn per disbursed loan, but lenders total everything monthly and pay in one credit the following cycle. Income becomes steady when your pipeline is steady: files sourced this month become next month's payout, which is why consistent sourcing beats occasional big pushes.


## Disclaimer


Nothing here is a guarantee of income. All commission rates and ranges are indicative industry figures at the time of writing; actual rates are set by each bank or NBFC in your DSA agreement and vary by product, location, volume, and campaign. GroMo commissions are set by partner lenders, are maximums that vary by campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission in the GroMo app before relying on any figure. This is general information, not financial or tax advice; consult a professional for TDS and GST treatment of your commission income.
